model: Cube 350 panel power meter (Modbus RTU option)
applies_to: Cube 350 three-phase panel meters fitted with the RS-485 Modbus option, per the June 2010 comms manual.
summary: The Cube 350 is a three-phase panel multifunction meter. With the Modbus option fitted it is an RS-485 Modbus RTU slave. Readings are integers: energy is a 32-bit copy of the display counter, and instantaneous values are signed 16-bit counts with power-of-ten scale registers. This map covers energy, instantaneous values, demand, THD and the setup registers.

addressing.note: Each table prints a 0-based data address next to its Modicon register number (512 = 40513). This map records the Modicon number; the data address is what goes on the wire, so request 512 to read 40513.

source.title: Cube350 Modbus Communications
source.pages: p. 4 (functions, exceptions); p. 5 (energy, eScale); p. 6 (instantaneous values, scaling); pp. 7-8 (peak hold, setup, demand, THD); p. 13 (specification)

notes: Northern Design does not host this manual publicly; the link is an unaltered copy on a distributor's file host.
32-bit values are a high word at the lower address followed by the low word (LONG = 65536 x high + low), so ABCD.

Energy registers hold the display digits without a decimal point. kWh = raw x 10^(eScale-6) and Wh = raw x 10^(eScale-3), with eScale read from register 513 (40514). The manual's formula names register 40513, which is the eScale high word; the worked example shows it means the energy count.

Instantaneous values are signed counts with no fixed scale: real value = raw x 10^(K-3), where K is Ki (2837), Kvp (2838), Kvl (2839) or Kp (2840). The K values follow the CT/PT programming and stay fixed once the meter is set up. These registers are listed with scale 1 and no unit, so the map shows raw counts.
Export kWh reads 0 on meters without export metering.

Left out: the amalgamated block 7680-7737 (copies of the main values; one row is an unqualified 'Kvarh'), the V/I harmonic tables 7936-9229 and the custom table 19200-19487, which only repeats registers you choose.
Supported functions: 03, 04, 06, 08 (loop-back only) and 16. A request returns at most 20 words.

integration.summary: Read the scale registers 2837-2840 and eScale (513) once after commissioning, then poll 2816-2836 and the energy block 514-529 with function 03 in requests of 20 words or fewer. Apply 10^(K-3) to instantaneous values and 10^(eScale-6) to energy.
integration.enable: Modbus is a fitted option. Two extra steps in the front-panel programming menu set the baud rate and the unique Modbus address.
quirks: Scale factors are exponents offset by 3 (value x 10^(K-3)), not plain SunSpec-style exponents.
Maximum 20 words per request; split larger block reads.
Allow at least 10 ms after each reply before the next request; replies can take up to 250 ms.
setup: RS-485 half duplex, two wires plus 0 V. Baud 4800, 9600 or 19200; address 1-247, both set on the front panel.
Fit 120 ohm terminators at the host and at the farthest meter; ground the cable shield at the host only.
gotchas: Energy, hours-run and peak registers are writable; a careless write resets a billing counter.
A non-zero Security PIN (3595) locks front-panel programming.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
